title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization in Direct Alignment Algorithms

live_model.evidence: Appendix B: "All evaluations were computed with 'gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09' as judge, with random positional flips to avoid known bias."

prompt.note: GPT4 win-rate judging follows AlpacaFarm-style protocols (Sec. 3, Fig. 1) but the judge prompt itself is not printed verbatim anywhere in the paper.

claim.metric: none for the live id (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 is only the automatic pairwise judge scoring Pythia policy summaries, not a subject being evaluated)

data.source: OpenAI TL;DR summarization preference dataset (92K pairs); 256 held-out prompts used for winrate evaluation (Appendix B)

notes: gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 is used exclusively as the GPT-4 winrate judge (Fig. 1, Fig. 8) comparing DPO/IPO/SLiC-trained Pythia policies (1B/2.8B/6.9B) against reference summaries; the paper reports no capability number for the judge model itself.
